question: How well does the latest canonical pre-tipoff NBA injury-report status predict whether that player plays in that game?

eligibility.unit: one canonical latest pre-tipoff observation per stable NBA game id and NBA player id

five_status_jeffreys.eligibility: at least 20 development observations for every status; otherwise this candidate is ineligible rather than emitting an unstable rate

selection_rule.primary_metric: Brier score on the chronological selection partition
selection_rule.rule: Advance to a more complex eligible candidate only if its Brier score is at least 0.005 lower than the current simpler candidate. Ties select the simpler candidate.
selection_rule.final_fit: Refit the selected structure on development plus selection without changing groups, priors, thresholds, or metrics.

secondary_metrics: paired Brier difference versus final-training global Jeffreys baseline
held_out_evaluation.calibration_table: one row per distinct emitted probability, with predicted mean, observed play rate, count, plays, and Wilson 95% interval
held_out_evaluation.status_table: count, plays, observed play rate, and Wilson 95% interval for every status; descriptive even when statuses share a pooled prediction

sensitivity.unknown_outcome: Report both all-play and all-non-play bounds for excluded joined unknown outcomes; neither scenario enters fitting or primary evaluation.
sensitivity.unresolved_identity: Report all-play and all-non-play status-level bounds for unresolved canonical observations; neither scenario enters fitting or primary evaluation.
sensitivity.report_timing: Report results by realized lead-time band if every reported band contains at least 10 eligible held-out observations; otherwise report counts only.

all_required: selected model is status-conditioned rather than global
upper endpoint of the paired-bootstrap 95% interval for held-out Brier difference versus the global baseline is below zero
absolute held-out calibration-in-the-large error is at most 0.10
every emitted held-out calibration bin contains at least 20 observations
every emitted probability lies inside its bin's Wilson 95% interval
held-out data includes at least 30 direct outcomes for every one of the five statuses
no monotonic reversal across unlikely, uncertain, and likely pooled bands
cohort fingerprint and every exclusion count reproduce exactly
activation_rule.failure_effect: Publish offline evidence and an activation veto; do not add runtime persistence, API, UI, or availability-model wiring.

planned_outputs: focused unit tests and model_backtest gate tests
append-only docs/handoff.md entry and accurate docs/backlog.md status
stopping_rule: Run the held-out evaluation once. Any post-unblind protocol change creates version 2 and leaves this freeze and version-1 result intact.
